verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public REST API with an endpoint reference browser, HTTP Basic auth conventions, error-diagnosis docs, and concrete endpoints for subscribers, events, broadcasts, chat and data deletion. These are backed by a Postman collection covering every endpoint and many first-party SDKs, which together let an AI-native user drive the account programmatically. Probes confirm machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented (community evidence only praises pricing).
